messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “best” month to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for, but most travelers agree that **late spring (April–May) and early fall (September–October)** strike the best balance between pleasant weather, lower crowds, and better rates.

| What you want | Why those months work |
|---------------|-----------------------|
| **Mild, sunny weather** | Average highs 78–84 °F (26–29 °C), lows 68–73 °F (20–23 °C). |
| **Fewer crowds** | School holidays end in early May and start again in late August, so you avoid the peak summer rush. |
| **Good deals** | Hotels and flights often drop in price after the summer peak, especially in September and October. |
| **Outdoor activities** | Great for hiking, snorkeling, and beach days without the intense heat of July‑August. |

If you’re a big‑ticket traveler who doesn’t mind crowds and wants the most “Hawaiian‑summer” vibe, **June–July** are still excellent—just expect higher prices and more tourists. Conversely, if you prefer the quietest, most budget‑friendly times, **November–March** are the off‑season months, though temperatures dip slightly and some attractions may have reduced hours.

So, for a blend of sunshine, fewer crowds, and reasonable prices, aim for **April, May, September, or October**.
